The rows the old ON DELETE CASCADE removed with the check and that never blocked a delete (voided rows, and the uninvoiced mortgage_handling event written when a check enters Review) are removed explicitly under the money-write flag (settleBillingEventsForCheckDelete; SQL 136's restrictive gate), so no provisional $10 row outlives its check; if they cannot be removed the delete is refused. Every other blocker is unchanged (deposit_items, checkalt_deposits, disbursement_batches, claim_check_payments, check_payment_directions, claim_disbursements, claim_checks_terminal, terminal financial state).
